test_objective: Check that an entity can be retrieved with an inline linked entity with sysAttrs
keywords: Create Initial Entity And Linked Entity
Delete Created Entity And Linked Entity

test_cases.name: 018_11_01 Retrieve Entity With Inline Linked Entity And SysAttrs
test_cases.doc: Check that an entity can be retrieved with an inline linked entity with sysAttrs
test_cases.setup: Create Initial Entity And Linked Entity
test_cases.teardown: Delete Created Entity And Linked Entity
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Retrieve Entity Request: and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${linking_entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: join set to 'inline' and
    Query Parameter: joinLevel set to '1' and
    Query Parameter: options set to 'sysAttrs' and
    Query Parameter: Link set to '<$https://easy-global-market.github.io/ngsild-api-data-models/ngsildTestSuite/ngsildTestSuiteV1.8-compound.jsonld>; rel="http://www.w3.org/ns/json-ld#context";type="application/ld+json"'
}
